tip: Start with V: top teeth touch your lower lip and buzz. Not "berry".
vay-KAY-shun. V with teeth on lip, stress on KAY.
example: We are planning a vacation in Lake Tahoe.

tip: Soft TH: tongue between your teeth, blow air, no voice. Not "tink" or "sink".
example: I think it is a good idea.

tip: Soft TH then R: tongue out, blow air, then "ree". Not "tree".
example: I have three apps on my phone.

tip: Soft TH + "awt". Rhymes with "bought". The gh is silent.
example: I parked that thought for later.

tip: -ed sounds like T: "workt", one syllable. Not "work-ed".
example: I worked on my habits today.

tip: After T, -ed is a full syllable: "WAN-tid".
